From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 04 Jul 2028 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Asteria Labs — procurement asks (need VP/CFO signoff)

Marissa / Markus,

Looping you on a tight-window ask from Asteria Labs (related to DL-2028-183). Customer wants:
- Adjusted list pricing at 50–150M tier: additional 20% off list (one-time concession for first 3 months of pilot)
- One-time onboarding credit: $50,000 to help with migration tooling and early telemetry
- Procurement deadline: legal prefers signature by 2028-07-12

Why this matters: Asteria is a strategic prospect in the biotech vertical — multi-product potential, reference value in biotech GTM. Ramp profile conservative; they have healthy long-term upside (we estimate 18–24 month ARR conversion if pilot succeeds).

Impact to economics (high level):
- Baseline ARR (if converted): ~$1.2M Y1
- One-time credit $50k = ~4% of year-1 recognized ARR in first 12 months
- Short-term bleed from 20% deeper discount but drives faster legal signoff and earlier consumption (likely to increase LTV)

Options for signoff (please highlight preferred):
A) Approve exactly as requested: -20% at 50–150M for initial 3 months + $50k onboarding credit; require 12-month minimum committed conversion clause (if they convert before 12 months apply true-up).
B) Approve partial: -15% and $35k onboarding credit, require 12-month commitment.
C) Decline concession; offer standard onboarding professional services at a discount and hold current price bands.

Requested action: 1) Mark preferred option + any guardrails (true-up, usage floors, DocuSign path) 2) If approved, can Marissa or Markus sign off so I can send a formal concession memo to procurement and legal? I attached the internal pricing model and a draft MAA for your review.

Thanks — this is time sensitive.

Ben
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Asteria_pricing_model_v3.xlsx; MAA_draft.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 05 Jul 2028 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Asteria Labs — procurement asks (need VP/CFO signoff)

Ben — thanks for the succinct summary and the modeling. I reviewed the numbers and stance with GTM. My position: APPROVE Option B with conditions.

Explicit approval (internal memo language you can forward):
"Marissa Cole, VP Sales — authorizes a one-time onboarding credit of $35,000 and a tiered concession of up to -15% off list at the 50–150M pilot tier for Asteria Labs (Deal DL-2028-183). Approval is conditional on (1) a signed 12-month conversion commitment within the MAA, (2) a usage true-up clause at conversion to full ARR, and (3) legal to verify that the onboarding credit is paid as a credit on first invoice and not as an uplift to committed spend. This concession is limited to the pilot term. Any further material change or deeper discount requires CFO signoff (Markus Klein)."

Markus — please countersign in thread if you are comfortable with the above. If you want to route to finance for a final check, please flag and I will hold sending to the customer until you confirm.

Ben — once Markus countersigns, proceed to update the proposal and share the DocuSign link with Emma & Carlos. Note: include clause: 12-month conversion minimum + true-up within 30 days of conversion.

—Marissa
